Creative case study

Beauty Studio

An authentic beauty routine with a message built around confidence and clarity.

CategoryBeauty & personal care
PlatformsFacebook & Instagram
FormatRoutine & experience
TypeCreative concept

The brief

Beauty creative needs to feel human while explaining the service or product clearly. Overloaded promises and generic visuals make it harder for someone to understand whether the offer is right for them.

The creative
direction.

Use the mirror and makeup footage as a familiar opening moment. Introduce one service or product benefit, show the experience, and finish with a booking or discovery prompt. Use readable captions and avoid unsupported product claims.

01 / Opening hook

A little time for you.

An example opening line to test with this footage.

02 / Next step

Discover your next beauty appointment

One action, aligned with the offer and the destination.

03 / Measurement

Track what matters.

Booking-page visits, appointment enquiries, and cost per booking.

This is a creative concept using licensed stock footage already featured on our site. Performance is measured after a campaign launches; no client results are claimed here.
